titleRequired: Give the diagram a name (at least 3 characters).
saveError: Saving did not work. Please try again.

leaveQuestion: Without a name the diagram cannot be saved. Close anyway? The drawing stays on this device.
embedHint: Copy it into the note or pick it there with “draw.io”. The note always shows the latest version.
